resources.string: Covers the row of status avatars at the top of WhatsApp\'s Chats screen. Reads WhatsApp\'s screen contents to find that row; nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
Hides the row of status avatars at the top of WhatsApp\'s Chats screen. The Updates tab still works.
Enable the No Stories accessibility service. On Android 13 and newer, first allow restricted settings for this app: Settings → Apps → No Stories → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings.
If the cover lands in the wrong place: open WhatsApp on Chats, come back here, and share the report. Forgetting the row makes the service work it out again from scratch.
No report yet. Open WhatsApp on the Chats tab first.
